title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Panikian, Municipality of Banaybanay, Province of Davao Oriental to Be Known as Panikian National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Panikian, Municipality of Banaybanay, Province of Davao Oriental to Be Known as Panikian National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Panikian, Thị trấn Banaybanay, Tỉnh Davao Oriental được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Panikian
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Panikian, เทศบาล Banaybanay, จังหวัด Davao Oriental ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Panikian
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Panikian, Kotamadya Banaybanay, Provinsi Davao Oriental dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Panikian

text.en: Establishment of a National High School. – There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay Panikian, Municipality of Banaybanay, Province of Davao Oriental to be known as Panikian National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Panikian National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
